about.title: About Us
about.seoTitle: About Padel Racket Reviews - Our Story & Experts
about.seoDescription: Learn about the team behind Padel Racket Reviews. We are passionate padel players dedicated to providing honest, data-driven racket reviews and buying advice.
about.heroSubtitle: We are a team of dedicated padel players and equipment nerds on a mission to help you find your perfect racket.
about.storyBody1: Padel Racket Reviews started from a simple frustration: it was too hard to find honest, comprehensive information about padel rackets online. Most stores just copy-pasted manufacturer descriptions, and independent reviews were scattered across different languages and platforms.
about.storyBody2: We decided to change that by creating a central hub for padel players of all levels. Our goal is to provide unbiased, data-backed insights into how different rackets actually perform on the court, not just what their marketing materials claim.
about.teamBody: Our testing team consists of players ranging from enthusiastic advanced amateurs to former professional competitors. With decades of combined racket sports experience, we know what separates a good racket from a great one.
about.missionBody: To empower padel players worldwide with the knowledge they need to make confident equipment choices and improve their game.

methodology.title: How We Review
methodology.seoDescription: Discover how we test and rate padel rackets. Learn about our rigorous on-court testing process and data-driven approach to evaluating power, control, and performance.
methodology.heroSubtitle: How we turn hours of on-court play into the numbers and reviews you trust.

processSteps.step1Body: Before hitting the court, we weigh and measure each racket, checking the balance point, face texture, and overall build quality against the manufacturer's specs.
processSteps.step2Body: Every racket is tested for a minimum of 10 hours of active play across different court conditions (indoor/outdoor) by at least two different testers of varying playstyles.
processSteps.step3Body: We score the racket across five key metrics: Power, Control, Rebound, Maneuverability, and Sweet Spot, carefully comparing it against benchmark rackets in its category.
processSteps.step4Body: We aggregate the testers' notes and scores to generate a comprehensive review, highlighting the specific type of player the racket is best suited for.

methodology.metricsIntro: Our 1-10 rating system is designed to provide clear, comparative data. Here is what each metric means:

metricsDescriptions.power: How much natural pace the racket generates on attacking shots like smashes and aggressive volleys.
metricsDescriptions.control: The precision and predictability of the racket, especially when placing the ball or defending.
metricsDescriptions.rebound: Also known as ball output (salida de bola). How much the ball bounces off the face with minimal swing effort, crucial for blocking and baseline defense.
metricsDescriptions.maneuverability: How easy the racket is to move quickly, particularly in fast net exchanges. Directly related to weight and balance.
metricsDescriptions.sweetSpot: The size and forgiveness of the optimal hitting area. A high score means fewer mishits.
